environment: Windows 11 Pro; Node.js v24.19.0; Vitest 4.1.11; V8 coverage provider; local test adapters and mocks; no backend/staging connection.

failure.test: WebLoginPage reports backend failure and keeps the user on the login route
failure.expected: Đăng nhập thất bại. Vui lòng kiểm tra thông tin và thử lại.
failure.observedInComponent: Không thể đăng nhập lúc này. Vui lòng thử lại.

testResults.repeatObservation: The same one-test failure reproduced in two full-suite runs: first with coverage enabled, then with the JSON reporter. This establishes a repeatable mismatch in these runs only; it is not a repository-wide flakiness assessment.

sourceInputFingerprint.note: Recomputed over all 435 coverage files, 282 test-graph roots, vitest.config.ts, package.json and package-lock.json; the 720-input fingerprint matches C03.01 exactly.

conclusion: Coverage thresholds pass without changes to configured thresholds or exclusions. The full suite is not green: 1 of 2386 tests fails on an existing WebLoginPage error-copy mismatch; the same mismatch reproduced in the second full-suite run. No product-intent source was identified, so neither the component copy nor the expected text was changed. This evidence completes the requested suite/coverage measurement but does not certify release readiness.
limitations: The UI error-copy mismatch remains an open product decision and a failing test gate; do not treat this step result as an all-green suite.
Two consecutive runs are insufficient to establish broad test stability or absence of flakes.
V8 coverage and MSW/fake transports measure frontend code paths only; they do not establish real backend authorization, persistence, replay, staging, production SLO, or user acceptance.
The raw output paths are machine-local temporary artifacts; hashes and summarized results are recorded here.
